summary_1line: Sesha performs severe penance, rejects his wicked serpent brothers, and is tasked by Brahma to support the Earth beneath the world.

image_candidates.scene_text: The emaciated serpent sage Sesha, with matted hair and ragged garments, stands in deep penance as Brahma appears before him in a radiant vision.
The colossal serpent Ananta coils beneath the Earth, lifting and supporting the world with its mountains and oceans upon his head.
Sesha descends through a dark crevice into the depths of the Earth as the globe above settles onto his vast serpent form.
